by
  have h_main : ¬ Function.Surjective f := by
    intro h_surj
    -- Define the set S = {x : α | x ∉ f x}
    let S : Set α := {x : α | x ∉ f x}
    -- Assume for contradiction that S is in the image of f
    have h₁ : ∃ (y : α), f y = S := by
      -- Since f is surjective, there exists y such that f y = S
      have h₂ : S ∈ Set.range f := by
        apply h_surj
      -- Obtain y such that f y = S
      rcases h₂ with ⟨y, hy⟩
      exact ⟨y, by simpa using hy⟩
    -- Obtain y such that f y = S
    rcases h₁ with ⟨y, hy⟩
    -- Consider whether y ∈ S or y ∉ S
    by_cases h : y ∈ S
    · -- Case: y ∈ S
      have h₂ : y ∉ f y := h
      have h₃ : f y = S := hy
      have h₄ : y ∉ S := by simpa [h₃] using h₂
      contradiction
    · -- Case: y ∉ S
      have h₂ : y ∈ f y := by
        have h₃ : y ∉ S := h
        have h₄ : y ∉ f y → False := by
          intro h₅
          have h₆ : y ∈ S := by
            have h₇ : y ∉ f y := h₅
            have h₈ : y ∈ S := by
              simpa [S, Set.mem_setOf_eq] using h₇
            exact h₈
          contradiction
        by_contra h₅
        exact h₄ h₅
      have h₃ : f y = S := hy
      have h₄ : y ∈ S := by simpa [h₃] using h₂
      contradiction
  exact h_main
